questions.q: In "Levels and can-do goals Define", which of these is a key idea?
o: Match formal and informal forms to the listener.
Separate slips from patterns; patterns need teaching.

questions.q: In "Speaking first Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Run it in four steps: listen, repeat, change one part, make your own.
Write an eight-week plan with a goal for each week.

Show a model, write together, then write alone.

Play short clips at natural speed after playing them first at slow speed.

Show a model, write together, then write alone.

o: Teach word families and common word pairs.
Show a model, write together, then write alone.
